name: How long does plumbing rough-in typically take for a kitchen or bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: How long does plumbing rough-in typically take for a kitchen or bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of plumbing rough-in can vary based on the scope of the remodel. For a standard bathroom, it might take a few days, while a more extensive kitchen remodel or one involving significant re-piping could take longer. We provide a detailed timeline during the planning phase, integrating plumbing work seamlessly with other remodel activities.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plumbing rough-in can take a few days for a standard bathroom or longer for extensive kitchen remodels, depending on scope.
